name: When I met you, Esther
source:
In a snowy village, there’s a woman named Sideralis. Most of the people in the village called her ‘odd’ due to her appearance. Yet, Sideralis still remained optimistic despite people having different views on her.

One day, while herding her father’s sheep before dusk arrives, she heard something amongst the dead forest. Knowing it’s dangerous to even step foot there as her father already scolded her one time, curiosity got the best of her. 

[From [url=https://haleythephantom.itch.io/when-i-met-you-esther]itch.io[/url]]
